_comment: SCCL v9 (Branch G of RESEARCH_NOTES_v5.md, 'BRANCH G PRE-REGISTRATION (V9 DOSE LADDER)', written and committed ad7172d BEFORE any v9 implementation or run). V9 tests whether a SOFTER rate threshold over a WIDER witness lane restores plasticity while keeping dominance: G=2 concurrent generalization witnesses per family (dedicated ':g' lane, manufactured at first contact from UNTRAINED stream tasks via the gold-free spec-only certify, retired before their source trains, refreshed from the next untrained task) under theta in {0.5, 2/3} with n=3 draws, margin recheck denominators {3,5}, stratified, cap probes on, anchor lambda=0.1 kept. PRE-REGISTERED RULES (per seed s): H1 plasticity restored (every treatment row >= 8 accepted updates at s; v8 theta=1.0 gave 14/4/6); H2 dominance kept (every treatment row arith >= sccl.arith at s, paired); H3 breakthrough (some treatment row arith >= 0.55 AND frontier >= sccl.frontier - 0.02 AND updates >= 5 at s). V9 VERDICT: BREAKTHROUGH CONFIRMED iff H3 at all 3 seeds; DOMINANCE CONFIRMED iff H2 at all 3 seeds; H1 FAIL at any seed -> dose finding (theta axis exhausted -> next branch pre- registers a witness-free drift bound); H1 PASS with H3 FAIL -> theta axis exhausted likewise; NO interpolated theta will be run. DEGENERACY GUARD: treatment row < 5 updates at any seed = degenerate there (excluded from H3 maxima, forces H3 FAIL there). FAIL-CLOSED per-seed checks in scripts/v9_check.py: C1 prefix bit-identity vs runs/sccl_v8 (s42) and runs/sccl_v8_s{43,44} (s43/s44); C2 engagement (first-contact manufacture of TWO ':g' probes per family, ':g' in checked_cap_ids, cap_retain_min == {0.5 | 0.666667}, cap_n == 3, denominators {3,5}, gen counters committed >= 4/row); C3 retirement/anti-contamination (no ':g' from T checked during/after T's training; ':g' sources disjoint from eval holdout ids); C4 isolation (prefix rows zero gen/E1/anchor activity; treatment rows anchor_pen>0 on every accepted update, lambda == 0.1); C5 gold-free 3-layer audit (as v8).
